query: WITH entities AS (SELECT created_at, id FROM notes WHERE (NOT $1 OR project_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM $2) AND (NOT $3 OR space_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM $4) AND (COALESCE((created_at, id) < ($7, $6), $6 IS NULL)) ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT $5) SELECT i.id AS "entity_id: Repo__Id", e.sequence, e.event, CASE WHEN $8 THEN e.context ELSE NULL::jsonb END as "context: es_entity::ContextData", e.recorded_at FROM entities i JOIN note_events e ON i.id = e.id ORDER BY i.created_at desc, i.id desc, i.id, e.sequence
